overview.description: Hapag Tanaw is a web-based restaurant reservation system designed to guide customers through the complete booking process, from selecting a schedule and food package to payment and confirmation. The platform uses a multi-step reservation flow to make the booking experience clear and organized, while providing public pages for visitors and secure reservation features for registered customers.

keyFeatures.title: Multi-Step Reservation Flow
keyFeatures.description: Guides customers through a structured booking process using a visual stepper: Reserve, Food Package, Payment, and Confirm.

keyFeatures.title: Authentication & Route Protection
keyFeatures.description: Provides customer sign-up and login functionality with storage-based sessions and route guards protecting secure reservation pages.

keyFeatures.title: Smart Reservation Validation
keyFeatures.description: Uses reactive forms and custom validation for customer details, Philippine mobile numbers, reservation dates, and valid restaurant time ranges.

keyFeatures.title: Food Package Selection
keyFeatures.description: Allows customers to browse and select food packages and à la carte items loaded dynamically from local JSON data sources.

keyFeatures.title: Reservation Summary & Editing
keyFeatures.description: Provides a confirmation step where customers can review and edit their reservation details before finalizing the booking.

keyFeatures.title: Custom Payment & Modal Experience
keyFeatures.description: Provides simulated GCash and Maya payment options together with reusable alert, warning, success, invalid-package, and confirmation modals.
